axis_convention: DEVICE order, verified against the Android CbctSeriesParser.cpp contract: the parser sets width=Columns, height=Rows and lays data as [depth][height][width] with slices sorted by ascending ImagePositionPatient z; PixelData is signed int16 LE (PixelRepresentation=1, RescaleIntercept=0, Slope=1). The model/label tensors are feat_dev[c][i][j][k] with i=device axis0=DICOM COLUMN (=host canonical axis1), j=device axis1=DICOM ROW (=host canonical axis0), k=z. Host canonical arrays are converted by transpose(0,2,1,3) (features) and transpose(1,0,2) (labels).
